rubric: rubric v2: strategy match 3 (gate below 2), risk/liquidity match 3, investability 2, data quality 2, provider independence 2, threshold 7/12
declared_none_reason: cell 5.1: the fund expressly declares no designated performance benchmark

primary.candidate: Peer cohort composite: private_credit without cliffwater_cclfx (bcred, cion_ares, ocic, pflex)
reasons: strategy_match 3/3: same asset class and sub-strategy (private_credit / direct_lending)
risk_liquidity_match 2/3: NAV-class series, annual observations vs the fund's daily return data and members span more than one leverage regime
investability 2/2: computable on held data (cohort composite from filings)
data_quality 1/2: annual composite with 4 overlapping fiscal years
provider_independence 2/2: provider unaffiliated with the fund (constructed (Tark cohort engine, leave-one-out))

comparison.window_note: 4 overlapping fiscal year(s) of 5 composite years
comparison.alignment_note: aligned by fiscal year-end year. Members' fiscal years end in month 06 (pflex), 12 (bcred, cion_ares, ocic), the fund's in month 03. Composite year(s) 2022 skipped: the fund has no whole fiscal year with that label (stub or partial period excluded)

composite.weighting: equal-weight across members reporting that fiscal year, aligned by fiscal year-end year. Stub and partial periods excluded

secondary.candidate: Senior loan investable proxy (BKLN, for Morningstar LSTA class)
reasons: strategy_match 2/3: the public-market version of the asset class (syndicated loans for direct lending)
risk_liquidity_match 1/3: daily-liquid market proxy vs a semi-liquid NAV fund, vol and liquidity regimes differ
investability 2/2: computable on held data (daily series)
provider_independence 2/2: provider unaffiliated with the fund (Invesco / Morningstar LSTA class)

comparison.schedule_note: ILLUSTRATIVE: 86 equal contributions, at the window start and each month-end inside it, valued at the window end. The two-point figure is primary.

reasons: strategy_match 3/3: same asset class and sub-strategy (private_credit / direct_lending)
risk_liquidity_match 2/3: NAV-class series, quarterly observations vs the fund's daily return data and an index, not a fund set, so leverage regime is not comparable
investability 0/2: index cited, series not held, not computable

provider_independence 0/2: index published by the fund's own adviser (Cliffwater). A manufacturer-owned yardstick sits poorly with the rule's conflict-free ethos, so it is usable as secondary color only
